# Lessons: qe-plan-verifier

Rules learned from calibration audits: cases where the plan verifier scored a plan 10/10 but a stricter audit found gaps. They are appended to the plan verifier's instructions on every run.

This file is managed by `node scripts/qe/qe.mjs lessons` (see `docs/qe-pipeline.md`). Each rule is a `## L<n>: <instruction>` heading followed by a tracking marker comment holding its category, subtype and date added. Changes arrive as pull requests.
